title: Welcome message with Wi-Fi details
description: Welcome guests on arrival with Wi-Fi, breakfast hours and the front desk number. Utility WhatsApp template for hotels and rentals.
notes: Triggered at check-in and tied to a stay in progress, so it qualifies as utility. Skip spa or restaurant promotions here.

body.text: Welcome to {{hotel}}, {{first_name}}! Wi-Fi network: *{{wifi_name}}*, password: *{{wifi_pass}}*. Breakfast is served from 7 to 10 AM. Dial 0 from your room for anything you need.
